note: What a server sends to state a unit's whole inventory at once, with each slot's cooldown, to the clients that can see the unit. The header names the unit.

fields.name: items
item
fields.note: The item, or zero to leave the slot empty, in which case its place's cooldowns are not used.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: A client does not read it: a place's position gives its slot.

fields.name: inSlot
fields.note: How many are in the slot.
Ten places, one per slot. A client empties every slot first, and reads only the first nine places, for slots 0 to 8 in order.

fields.name: cooldowns

items.name: cooldown
items.note: How long is left, in seconds. -1 leaves the slot's wait as it was, and the whole cooldown with it.

fields.note: Each slot's cooldown left, in the same order; a client reads only the first nine.

fields.name: maxCooldowns
fields.note: Each slot's whole cooldown, in the same order; a client reads only the first nine.
